Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

perglm 0.0.0.9000

  • Introduce perglm_test() for permutation-calibrated, empirically studentized GLM score tests, returning a standard R htest object.
  • Support Gaussian, Bernoulli, Poisson, Gamma, inverse Gaussian, and negative binomial working families, with standard named links and fixed offsets. Negative binomial size can be fixed or estimated under a log-link null model.
  • Provide fixed-budget marginal exposure permutations, two-sided and one-sided alternatives, inclusive ties, and the plus-one p-value correction. Support reproducibility with set.seed() and optional retention of permuted scores.
  • Fit the nuisance-only null model once and reuse score quantities and QR factors. Use compiled C++ kernels and bounded batches for permutation scoring.
  • Require complete observations, unit prior weights, a full-rank nuisance design with an intercept, and identifiable exposure variation. Check null-model convergence and empirical score variance. Reject separated Bernoulli fits and Gaussian fits with residuals indistinguishable from numerical roundoff. Undefined sampled scores stop the test without discarding or redrawing permutations.
  • Add an executable getting-started vignette, a package website, installation instructions, and citations for the method and software.
  • Add GitHub Actions checks on Linux, macOS, and Windows, including vignettes and the minimum supported R version, 4.1.0.
  • Require testthat 3.1.7 or later for the namespace mocking used by the tests.

Developed by Ziang Niu.
